items.title: Friday night will be ‘coldest of the autumn so far’, UK forecasters say
items.summary: Lows will be ‘severe’ in the north, down to -9C, with some sub-zero temperatures farther south Friday night will be the coldest night of the autumn so far, forecasters have said, surpassing the previous chilliest: Thursday. A low of -8.4C was recorded at Tulloch Bridge in the Scottish Highlands overnight, according to the Met Office. Sub-zero temperatures were also recorded in Northern Ireland. More southerly areas stayed substantially warmer overnight on Thursday. Continue reading...
